description: RedCap Forge is the concrete pipeline that turns private runtime experience into reviewed, deduplicated, safe, indexable public knowledge candidates. Evolution Factory remains the broader self-evolution system name.

responsibilities.meaning: Identify high-value signals from reports, lessons, Prism verdicts, failures, user corrections, and closeout blockers.
Rewrite raw traces into problem-source, solution, final-effect, applicability boundary, and evidence-backed entries.
Remove secrets, local private paths, identity text, raw runtime evidence, and user-private material before public consideration.
Reject exact duplicates through normalized fingerprints and send near-duplicates to Prism or human review when needed.
Map distilled material to shared-knowledge entry kinds, skill candidates, lessons, governance rules, or explicit no-promote decisions.
Create or refresh metadata-first indexes so arsenal can be searched without bulk-loading entry bodies.
Append reviewed public entries to redcap-arsenal or keep private/no-promote with an evidence-backed reason.

public_promotion_gates: package publish safety secret-pattern scan or equivalent candidate-content scan
Prism review when the candidate changes behavior, public claims, or user-visible doctrine
must_not_claim: Do not claim Evolution Factory means every candidate is public.
Do not claim RedCap Forge can publish raw reports.
Do not claim redcap-arsenal is mature or complete just because it contains a first reviewed-substantive entry set.
Do not auto-edit active identity anchors from Forge output.
